topic: Day 146 — reel — A clumsy true answer beats a smooth false one
text:
A clumsy
truth beats
a [smooth] lie.
caption:
An awkward honest sentence still transfers accurate information. A polished dishonest one transfers none, however well it lands.

Follow for one of these a day.
